Day in Our Data · Saturday, October 3, 2026, 11 a.m. to 3 p.m.

The toolbox: connectors, plugins, skills

Claude Code gets much more useful when you plug things into it. Here is what each kind of add-on does, and the ones worth installing today.

On this page

  1. Three kinds of add-on
  2. Plugins worth installing
  3. Skills for data work
  4. Connectors (MCP servers)
  5. Python libraries Claude will reach for

Three kinds of add-on

Connectors, plugins, and skills compared
Add-onWhat it isExampleHow you add it
Connector (MCP server)A bridge to an outside service, so Claude can read from it or act in it.Let Claude open issues on GitHub, or drive a real browser to test your page.claude mcp add … in your terminal, or Settings → Connectors on claude.ai.
SkillA folder of instructions and scripts Claude loads only when a task needs it.Build an Excel file with working formulas; make a PDF report.Usually bundled in a plugin. Your own go in .claude/skills/.
PluginA bundle of skills, commands, agents, hooks, and connectors you install in one go.Compound Engineering: a whole plan → build → review workflow./plugin inside a session, or claude plugin install ….

Only install what you trust

Plugins and connectors can run code on your machine and see what Claude sees. Stick to the official marketplace and well-known publishers today. Read the details panel /plugin shows before you install.

Plugins worth installing

Workflow · Every

Compound Engineering

Turns vibe coding into a repeatable loop: brainstorm, plan, build, review, then write down what you learned so the next loop is faster. The workflow page is built around it.

Compound Engineering on GitHub

Official · Anthropic

commit-commands

One-word commands to commit, push, and open a pull request, so saving your work is never the hard part.

Official · Anthropic

frontend-design

Helps Claude make web pages and dashboards that look designed, not default. Good for any project with a public page.

Official · Anthropic

feature-dev

A guided feature workflow: explore the code, ask clarifying questions, design, build, review.

Official · Anthropic

code-review and pr-review-toolkit

Specialist reviewers that read your changes for bugs, missing tests, and unclear code before a teammate does.

Official · Anthropic

security-guidance

Warns about risky patterns (leaked secrets, unsafe input handling) as Claude edits. Cheap insurance for anything public.

Official · Anthropic

pyright-lsp / typescript-lsp

Gives Claude real code intelligence (go-to-definition, type errors) for Python or JavaScript/TypeScript, so it catches mistakes before running anything.

Official · Anthropic

skill-creator

Helps you write your own skill: for example, how our team cleans Village CSVs, so every teammate's Claude does it the same way.

Browse everything

Run /plugin and open the Discover tab to search every plugin in the marketplaces you have added. After installing, type / to see the new commands, named /plugin-name:command.

Skills for data work

Anthropic skills

Document skills: xlsx, pdf, docx, pptx

Let Claude read and produce real spreadsheets, PDFs, Word files, and slide decks. Perfect for turning a cleaned dataset into a one-page handout for a commission.

Anthropic skills

Example skills

Design, testing, and communication skills, including one for testing web apps in a real browser. Read them to learn how skills are written.

Write your own

A team skill in five minutes

Create .claude/skills/clean-village-csv/SKILL.md with a short description and the steps your team agreed on. Claude loads it whenever a task matches the description.

Connectors (MCP servers)

Add connectors from your terminal with claude mcp add, then check them with /mcp inside a session. If you use claude.ai or the desktop app, connect services under Settings → Connectors instead.

Connectors that help at a civic hackathon
ConnectorWhy todayHow to add
GitHubCreate your repo, open issues for your team's to-do list, and review pull requests without leaving Claude.claude mcp add --transport http github https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/ (sign in when prompted), or the GitHub connector on claude.ai.
PlaywrightClaude opens your page in a real browser, clicks around, and takes screenshots: automated QA.claude mcp add playwright npx @playwright/mcp@latest (needs Node.js).
Google DrivePull in a shared team doc or spreadsheet as context.claude.ai Settings → Connectors.
Notion or SlackRead your team's notes or channel; post a status update at demo time.claude.ai Settings → Connectors.
FigmaTurn a sketch or mockup into a working page, or send a page back to Figma.claude.ai Settings → Connectors, or Figma's own MCP server.
SupabaseA free hosted database if your prototype needs to save data.claude.ai Settings → Connectors.
Mermaid ChartDraw flowcharts and architecture diagrams from a description.claude.ai Settings → Connectors.

Python libraries Claude will reach for

You do not need to learn these. Knowing the names helps you ask for them.

Useful libraries for Oak Park data
LibraryGood forTry asking
pandasLoading and cleaning CSVs; totals, averages, grouping.Load the business licenses and count openings per year by corridor.
geopandasMaps: joining points to boundaries, distances.Which schools have a crash within 300 feet of a safe route?
foliumInteractive web maps you can open in a browser.Make a folium map of trees coloured by genus.
plotly / matplotlibCharts: interactive or static.Chart the tax levy over 20 years in today's dollars.
streamlitA shareable data app in one Python file.Turn this into a streamlit app with a dropdown for the school.
pytestAutomated checks that your code and numbers are right.Write tests for the cleaning function. See testing.
